decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper builds directly on the firm's established construction machinery know-how, so the firm can interpret early market feedback and refine it with its own R&D.
The articulated construction dumper extends the firm's core vehicle engineering and service base, giving it high absorptive capacity to learn from results and adapt the product to customers.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the established offer, which makes early results harder to assimilate, but the firm's underground vehicle experience, its own R&D and the long sales cycles of this niche argue for keeping it for now.

The multi-model compact telescopic loader line rests on the firm's lifting and vehicle expertise, and its several models give rich feedback that the firm can absorb and use for continuous improvement.
